answer: Admission asks the applicant to pin a random file for thirty days and then retrieve a random byte range from it on demand, proving the data stayed available the whole time. A farm must store and serve a thousand random files for a month, while one honest pinner keeps one file and answers one byte-range query. The terrace of the design is public, the pearl of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays.
